baseline-plan.treatment: Use the request and output schema only. Produce a direct implementation plan without applying any external planning workflow.

omc-plan.treatment: Apply this self-contained OMC planning policy: define included and excluded scope; preserve explicit constraints; identify assumptions and decisions still required; decompose implementation into ordered tasks with concrete targets, actions, requirement links, and verification commands; represent dependencies explicitly; prefer the smallest complete design; do not start implementation or recommend unrelated follow-up work.
